name: Cliche Otome
source:
The protagonist is back to school for the spring, attending school with four of Gakko High's most attractive bachelors and bachelorettes. Which one will you choose to take to the Spring Festival this trimester?

[From [url=https://babydev.itch.io/cliche-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
